description:
Project: website — Restaurant with online ordering

Business: Alibaba Grillade, serving Arabic style grilled meats like filet mignon, shish taouk, chicken, kafta, and maaneh.

Goal: Drive takeout orders.

Target audience: Hungry customers looking for grilled Arabic food.

Key features:
- Prominent direct link to third-party ordering platform for takeout.
- Menu display.

Design & brand:
- Colors: Black, gold, and a bit of white.
- Mood: Modern, luxurious.
- Signature: The unique, smoky flavor from their special wood grill setup — the only one in the Laurentides.
- First impression / photos & logo: A bold first impression featuring a high-quality photo of meats grilling on the unique wood charcoal setup.

designManifest.copyVoice: Low, confident maître-de-braise French declaratives with a smaller English echo beneath ('Grillé au bois. Rien d’autre. / Wood-grilled. Nothing else.') — no adjective the food can't prove.
designManifest.heroThesis: A full-bleed photo of marinated skewers over live wood coals with a headline naming the one true claim — the only wood grill in the Laurentides — and a single gold order button, nothing else between the visitor and dinner.
designManifest.iconDirection: Charcoal-black tile with three thin gold grate lines interrupted by a Fraunces 'A' monogram sitting on the middle rule like a piece of meat on the grill.
designManifest.signatureMove: The Grate Rule System: every section is separated by twin 1px gold rules spaced like grill grates, carrying a heat gradient (#C9A24B → #E8722C) that intensifies to full heat as it approaches an order CTA, so the whole page feels like one continuous grill.
designManifest.summary: The page reads as one long wood-charcoal grill — black as the coals, gold as the flame — with twin gold grate rules dividing every section and a single gold order button standing between the customer and dinner.
designManifest.typography: Fraunces (700/900, high optical size) for display headlines and dish names — carved and luxurious; Work Sans (400/500) for body and the bilingual echo lines; all-caps Work Sans 600 tracked for labels and the CTA.

directions.pitch: Votre gril au bois est le seul dans les Laurentides — cette direction le met en pleine page dès la première seconde, noir et or comme la braise elle-même, avec un seul bouton doré qui mène directement à la commande.

Cette direction vend le moment — la soirée où toute la rue sent votre fumée — avec une nuit indigo qui fait briller votre feu comme aucun fond noir ordinaire ne le peut, pour que commander chez Alibaba devienne le rituel du vendredi soir.

Ici, c'est votre menu qui devient l'affiche de luxe — filet mignon, shish taouk, kafta en lettres immenses sur fond papier boucher, lisible en trois secondes par un client affamé, avec le prix et le bouton commander toujours à portée de pouce.

promptHistory.changeNotes:
Admin enrichment: (1) Dashboard rebuilt with icon stat cards, a prominent order-link status alert (warns when the online-order URL is missing, confirms when active), richer module cards with live counts, and two grouped settings cards — order settings (URL/platform/pickup time) and operational settings (business name, phone, email, address, hours) all editable via a generic per-card saver hitting PUT /api/admin/settings. (2) Module admin pages (menu + posts) gained descriptive subheaders, a live search/filter, an Annuler button in the modal, and clearer '+ New' CTAs. (3) admin.js upgraded: image thumbnails, status pills for boolean fields (En vedette/Disponible/Publié), formatted price cells, non-blocking toast feedback replacing alert(), in-place list refresh after create/edit/delete (no full reload flicker), confirm-before-delete, focus management, and attribute-safe escaping (escAttr) plus placeholder/hint support in generated forms. (4) admin-styles.css fully modernized with an --admin-brand token, accessible focus-visible states, pills, toasts, alerts, ghost buttons, sticky sidebar/modal header, and responsive grids. All existing routes, data flows, i18n public views, editable-content annotations, and {{IMG_*}} tokens preserved. Menu items (with price/availability/featured) remain fully admin-manageable — the functional CRUD contract is met. No new external keys added.

Fixed the routing catch-all so /admin/login and /admin/logout now fall through to the platform's admin handler instead of bouncing to the homepage; removed the dead duplicate catch-all block. Homepage menu section now shows only a 2-dish teaser per category (via a trimmed grouping passed into partials/menu-list) plus a 'see full menu' link, restoring rhythm above the hours/contact sections. Prices now format as $24.99 in English and 24,99 $ in French. Added dotted price leaders and heat-gradient category dividers to the menu, gold focus-visible outlines site-wide, fetchpriority/lazy-loading hints on homepage and news images.
